annotations.title: Promote catalog product groups in a Pinterest ad group

description: Attach catalog PRODUCT GROUPS to a Pinterest Shopping (CATALOG_SALES) ad group — this is what makes a Shopping ad group serve products. Created PAUSED by default; creating them ACTIVE under a LIVE campaign and ad group starts real spend, so that needs an explicit yes and confirm:true. Optional bid (ad account currency), included:false to exclude a group, creativeType, cta, trackingUrl. Read back from Pinterest. 0 credits.

adAccountId.description: Pinterest ad account id — omit to use the single shared account

adGroupId.description: CATALOG_SALES ad group to attach the product groups to

bid.description: bid in the ad account currency

confirm.description: true required to create ACTIVE promotions under a live campaign and ad group

cta.description: catalog sales CTAs: SHOP_NOW, BOOK_NOW, ON_SALE, GET_DEAL

included.description: false excludes these product groups instead of including them

productGroupIds.description: catalog product group ids to promote

trackingUrl.description: tracking URL appended to clicks on these promotions

name: create_pinterest_ads_product_group_promotion
title: Promote catalog product groups in a Pinterest ad group
